description: Defines the ListCommand class for listing HAL services and related information in Android's hardware abstraction layer (HAL) management tool.

classes.name: ListCommand
classes.description: A command class for listing Android HAL services, libraries, and manifests with options for filtering and output formatting.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Executes the main logic of the list command.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command.

methods.name: getSimpleDescription
methods.description: Provides a brief description of the command.

methods.name: putEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry to a specific HAL type table.

methods.name: fetchManifestHals
methods.description: Fetches HALs listed in the VINTF manifest.

methods.name: fetchBinderizedEntry
methods.description: Fetches a specific binderized HAL entry.

methods.name: getPidInfo
methods.description: Retrieves process info for a given PID.

methods.name: getPidInfoCached
methods.description: Retrieves cached process info for a PID.

methods.name: addLine
methods.description: Adds a line of data to a table.

methods.name: addLine (overload)
methods.description: Adds a data entry to a table.

methods.name: removeDeadProcesses
methods.description: Removes dead processes from PID list.

methods.name: resolvePartition
methods.description: Resolves process partition based on context.

methods.name: getVintfInfo
methods.description: Retrieves VINTF info for an instance.

methods.name: tableForType
methods.description: Retrieves table for specific HAL type.

methods.name: addEntryWithInstance
methods.description: Adds HAL entry with instance info.

methods.name: addEntryWithoutInstance
methods.description: Adds HAL entry without instance info.

methods.name: shouldFetchHalType
methods.description: Determines if a HAL type should be fetched.
